description: NarrativeTrace for .NET records each traced interface call, its parameters and its result as log lines through the Microsoft.Extensions.Logging bridge, and writes a value-free structural trace per test. Install the NarrativeTrace.Proxy package from NuGet, add NarrativeTrace.Logging for the logging bridge, and install the NarrativeTrace.Cli tool.
rules: Install with dotnet add package NarrativeTrace.Proxy, then dotnet new tool-manifest and dotnet tool install NarrativeTrace.Cli; keep every NarrativeTrace.* package on the same version.

dotnet tool run dotnet-narrativetrace init --dry-run previews the agent skills it copies into .agents/skills and .claude/skills plus a marked AGENTS.md section; run it without --dry-run only after reading the diff.

Choose one capture path per project with documentation/choosing-an-integration.md (test fixture, NarrativeTraceProxy.Create, AddNarrativeTracing or the ASP.NET Core middleware); Logging and Observability layer on top of it.

Values whose parameter names or shapes match the redaction rules are replaced with [REDACTED] before any output; keep secrets out of traced parameters and prove redaction with a test that asserts [REDACTED].

Only calls through an interface wrapped by NarrativeTraceProxy or AddNarrativeTracing are traced; private and internal calls are not, so read the run's actual output before describing what the application did.
documentation/guides/llms.txt is the curated reference with the install block and known traps; documentation/recipes/ holds complete worked examples organised by problem.
